subject: DAG injection: follow supersededBy to current head in /search
description:
In routes/graph.js the DAG-tier injection loop (around lines 168-182) pushes every context_dep note node verbatim, with NO temporal handling. When a context_dep points at a note that has since been superseded, the stale note is injected at score 1.0 / inject:true — and for a fully-judged task (dagOnly=true) the RAG-fill that would surface the current note is dropped, so the replacement never appears.

FIX: in that DAG loop, before pushing a context_dep note, follow its supersededBy chain to the current head and inject the HEAD note (current truth) instead of the stale one.

Key facts (already verified):
- In the BUILT graph (g.tasks), note nodes carry `supersededBy` ALREADY prefixed as 'note:'+id (daemon.js:1619), matching the node `id` format. So walk via g.tasks.find(t => t.id === noteNode.supersededBy) — no re-prefixing.
- The current head is the note whose supersededBy is null/falsy.
- Add a cycle guard (seen Set) and handle a supersededBy that points to a node NOT present in g.tasks (e.g. archived) — in that case stop at the last resolvable node.
- Dedup: if the resolved head is already in dagNotes (another dep resolved to the same head, or it's already a direct context_dep), skip the duplicate so it isn't injected twice (dagKeys is built AFTER the loop — account for that).
- Use the head note's key/title/summary for the injected entry; keep score 1.0, tier 'dag', kind 'note'. The `path` should still reflect it is a context_dep of task/<task_key> (optionally note it was followed through a supersede chain).

SCOPE: routes/graph.js only, plus a regression test. Do NOT change RAG behavior, do NOT touch supersedeNote/edge rewiring (that's a separate concern). Match existing style in the file.

TEST: add a regression test (follow the existing test harness pattern in test/) that: creates note A, supersedes A with B (overlayStore.supersedeNote or record_decision supersedes), wires A as a context_dep of a task, then asserts GET /search?task_key=<task> injects B (current head) at tier:'dag' and does NOT inject A. Run it and confirm pass.

summary: Fixed DAG-tier injection in routes/graph.js to follow each context_dep note's supersededBy chain to the current head (cycle-guarded; stops at last resolvable node if chain points off-graph; deduped on resolved head id), so superseded notes are no longer injected stale at score 1.0 and the current replacement surfaces even under dagOnly (RAG-fill dropped). Added test/dag-supersede-head.test.js (real-API supersede chain + asserted context edge; fails without the fix). All existing search/temporal tests pass. Committed as 639c2c8 on the attempt branch.
